description: Defines a utility class ObjectUtils for handling JSON objects, including methods to check and add boolean and string entries, create JSON strings, and perform serialization.

classes.name: ObjectUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for manipulating JSON objects and boolean/string values within a C++ project.

methods.name: bool HasBooleanEntry(const JsonObject & obj,const string & key,bool & resultValue)
methods.description: Checks if a JsonObject contains a boolean entry for a given key and retrieves its value.

methods.name: string CreateBooleanJsonString(const string & key,const bool value)
methods.description: Creates a JSON string with a boolean key-value pair.

methods.name: JsonObject CreateBooleanObject(const string & key,const bool value)
methods.description: Creates a JsonObject with a boolean key-value pair.

methods.name: void AddBooleanEntry(JsonObject & obj,const string & key,const bool value)
methods.description: Adds a boolean key-value pair to an existing JsonObject.

methods.name: bool HasStringEntry(const JsonObject & obj,const string & key,string & resultValue)
methods.description: Checks if a JsonObject contains a string entry for a given key and retrieves its value.

methods.name: string BoolToJsonString(const bool value)
methods.description: Converts a boolean value to its JSON string representation ('true' or 'false').
